label: Lobby
description: For a lobby server: tells each player which game server to join and shows its /connect address on screen after a short countdown. Quake Live does not let a server move a player, so players type the command themselves. A player's destination comes from a personal route set by a referee, a tournament assignment the hub writes into the server's Redis, or the default destination.

commands.name: lobby
commands.description: Lists the destination servers and your own route.

commands.name: go
commands.description: Shows the /connect address of a destination: the slug you give, else your route, else the default.

commands.name: lobbyset
commands.description: Saves a personal route for a player (client id or name).

commands.name: lobbyclear
commands.description: Removes a player's personal route; without an id, removes your own.

commands.name: lobbysend
commands.description: Shows a player the /connect address of a destination now: the slug you give, else their route.

commands.name: lobbynotify
commands.description: Re-checks tournament assignments from the hub for everyone on the server and shows any new ones.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns automatic routing on or off. When off, !go and !lobbysend still work and players may join teams.

cvars.label: Public Host
cvars.description: Address players are told to connect to. Empty uses net_ip, else 127.0.0.1. A destination whose host is HOST uses this address.

cvars.label: Destinations
cvars.description: Destination servers, separated by semicolons. Each is slug|host|port|label|password|tags; password and tags are optional. Example: c1|HOST|27961|Championship 1

cvars.label: Default Destination
cvars.description: Slug used for players without a personal route. With only one destination configured, that one is used.

cvars.label: Auto Redirect
cvars.description: After a player loads, counts down and then shows the /connect address of their destination, without waiting for !go.

cvars.label: Redirect Delay (s)
cvars.description: Length of that countdown in seconds.

cvars.label: Force Spectator
cvars.description: Moves every player to spectator when they load into the lobby.

cvars.label: Stay-In-Lobby Permission
cvars.description: Players with at least this permission level, and the server owner, are not routed and may join teams.

cvars.label: Connect Message
cvars.description: Extra line shown on screen when a player uses !go or is sent with !lobbysend.

cvars.label: Instances JSON
cvars.description: Path on the game host to a JSON file with an "instances" list. Each enabled, non-lobby instance becomes a destination on port 27960 plus its id. Destinations above win on a slug clash.

cvars.label: Hub Countdown (s)
cvars.description: Seconds a player counts down before the /connect address of their tournament server appears, when the hub's assignment does not set its own delay.

cvars.label: Hub Countdown
cvars.description: When on, a tournament assignment from the hub is shown after that countdown; when off, at once. !lobby and !go never count down.
